tasks.short: Review facility data for planning, cash, and risk.

steps.what: Show facility activity and cash totals
Review and analyze facility activities and data
Decide the cash and risk actions
Sign the planning note for this period
File the signed planning note
outputs: filed copy of signed planning note v1

tasks.design: A job shows facility activity and cash totals from {BI}. The manager reviews the data for planning, cash and risk management, and service utilization. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. A model does not decide the risk.
tasks.previous_blocker: Activity and cash figures were copied before the planning meeting.
tasks.enabler_now: Those totals are already in the finance and booking records.
tasks.still_hard: Risk can sit in a contract the total does not show.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides the planning action.

ambition.what: Review utilization the week the cash total is posted.

tasks.altitude: The manager spends the week on the risk, not on copying totals.

evidence.claim: The health digest says budgets and reports are generated from the booking record, and any commentary is checked against the figures.
The health digest says strategy and people decisions stay manual, with drafting help only, and there is no agent.

assumptions: Totals come from the booking and finance records.
Configure those records before a new store.
unknowns: Which cash figure is the official one.
Who else signs a risk action.
research_questions: How often utilization data lags the ward.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining review time is still the manager's analysis.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes totals arrive late. The high end assumes totals are posted on time. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Assemble stored status of programs and services
Draft the activity report from status rows

loop.purpose: Draft report commentary only from stored activity rows.
loop.output: Commentary in which every figure cites an activity row.
loop.check: Every figure matches a stored activity row.
loop.stop: Stop when a figure has no activity row.
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed table cannot write the status the manager still has to judge.

steps.what: Prepare implementation plans and quality initiatives
Sign the activity report for management
File the signed activity report
outputs: filed copy of signed activity report v1

tasks.design: A job assembles program and service status from {PROJECT}. A bounded draft writes the activity report only from those rows and stops when a figure has no row. The manager prepares the implementation plans and quality initiatives, signs the report, and a later job files that version in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Status reports were rewritten from memory, and a figure could appear with no program row.
tasks.enabler_now: Program and service status is already stored.
tasks.still_hard: A quality initiative still needs the manager's judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides what management is told and signs the report.

ambition.what: Send management the status the week the program rows close.

tasks.altitude: The manager spends the week on the plan, not on copying status tables.

reach.learn: Which rows the report may cite

evidence.claim: The health digest says budgets and reports are generated from the booking record, and any commentary is checked against the figures.
Digest [S15] records a model-drafted review that cited non-existent sources and a fabricated court case, so every cited rule must match a stored row.

assumptions: Every figure must trace to a status row.
Configure the existing project record before a new store.
unknowns: Who in management must receive the report.
research_questions: How often a status row changes after the draft.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining planning time is still the manager's judgement.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes status rows are incomplete. The high end assumes status rows are complete at month end. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop medical programs for research and community health.

steps.what: Develop medical programs that promote research
Expand rehabilitation and community health services
Implement the health services that were agreed
Sign the medical program for this version
File the signed medical program
outputs: filed copy of signed medical program v1

tasks.design: The manager develops or expands medical programs and health services that promote research, rehabilitation, and community health, and implements what was agreed. A later job files the signed program in {DOCS}. It does not launch the service.
tasks.previous_blocker: Program ideas lived in meetings and had no single signed version.
tasks.enabler_now: The project list can hold the signed program.
tasks.still_hard: A community service still needs partners the record does not contain.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides which program is implemented.

ambition.what: Offer a signed community program the facility can explain to partners.

tasks.altitude: The manager spends the week on the program, not on scattered notes.

evidence.claim: The health digest says strategy and people decisions stay manual, with drafting help only, and there is no agent.

assumptions: The job does not open a service by itself.
Configure the existing project list before a new tool.
unknowns: Which research the facility may promote.
research_questions: How often a community need is outside the facility's licence.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining program time is still the manager's decision.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes partners are undecided. The high end assumes the service outline is already agreed. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Consult medical, business, and community groups.

steps.what: Consult medical and business groups on service problems
Respond to community needs and public relations
Promote health programs and coordinate the plans
Sign the consultation note for this meeting
File the signed consultation note
outputs: filed copy of signed consultation note v1

tasks.design: The manager consults medical, business, and community groups, responds to community needs, and promotes health programs. A later job files the note the manager signed in {DOCS}. It does not publish a statement.
tasks.previous_blocker: What a community group asked for was lost after the meeting.
tasks.enabler_now: The calendar already holds the meeting.
tasks.still_hard: Public relations still depend on the manager's words in the room.
tasks.human_edge: The manager decides what is promised.
tasks.altitude: The manager spends the week in the consultation, not retyping the note.

reach.task: Hold the facility to the signed note

evidence.claim: The health digest says strategy and people decisions stay manual, with drafting help only, and there is no agent.

assumptions: The note is internal until the manager sends it.
Configure the existing calendar before a new tool.
unknowns: Whether a public line needs a second signature.
research_questions: How often a community need is outside the facility's services.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining meeting time is still the manager with the group.

incremental.description: Remap source fields when the record layout changes, and clear exceptions the job cannot file.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes groups meet rarely. The high end assumes meetings are already on the calendar. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The health services manager spends the week on the unit, the people, and the signed decision. A schedule draft and a filed report can move. No model hires, evaluates, rosters, or sends a calamity report.
reach: A department head sees the schedule only after the manager signs it.
Finance receives the fiscal note the manager signed, not a generated rate.
skills_to_grow: Reject a report figure that has no source row.
Keep hiring, evaluation, and the roster as their own decision.
role.ambitious_version: A signed report or policy can be filed the same day, and the manager still decides it.
